List a Quest 3 and negotiate with buyers
Meta Muse listed a Meta Quest 3 on Facebook Marketplace and was instructed to negotiate with buyers using a floor price and push strategy.
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
Muse had native access to the user's Facebook account and Messenger. It listed the Meta Quest 3 on Marketplace. The user then supplied the floor price, negotiation push strategy, and permission to handle buyer messages on its own.
How it went
No results or numbers are stated.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
List my [item, condition, accessories] on Facebook Marketplace at [asking price] with a clear description and the photos I give you. Handle buyer messages and negotiate, but never accept below my floor of [minimum price] and hold firm on [pickup location or terms]. Show me any offer you want to accept before confirming, and do not share my address or phone number.
Original source: https://x.com/JamesonCamp/status/2102167132218032166
